blocks.text: Mid Meadows homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Mid Meadows, October 2026. Detached houses: 6 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 33%. Condos and townhomes: 10 listed at month end and 4 sold in October, a sales ratio of 40% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 9 sold over 5 months against an average of 8.2 listed, about 4.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 19 sold over 5 months against an average of 13.2 listed, about 3.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 5 sold.

faq.q: Which public schools serve Mid Meadows?
faq.a: Davie Jones Elementary at 12030 Blakely Road and Edith McDermott Elementary at 12178 Bonson Road are both physically in the sub-area, and Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue is the public secondary school for Pitt Meadows; SD42 has no middle tier, and for the sample address used (10932 Barnston View Road), the SD42 locator gives Davie Jones Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary — catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.

Routes 719 and 722 run as a combined circular service through Bonson Road and Fraser Way to Meadowtown, Pitt Meadows Station and Maple Meadows Station, and route 701 runs along Hammond Road at the north edge to Coquitlam Central Station and Haney Place.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 10 condos and townhomes listed with 4 sold in the month in Mid Meadows. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mid Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% on too few listings to read as a market type; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 40%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
